currentParagraphText: “I greet the Chosen of the Malefic One... and I apologize that I’m currently in an indisposed state,” she said, the only thing moving her mouth.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I greet the Chosen of the Malefic One... and I apologize that I’m currently in an indisposed state,” she said, the only thing moving her mouth.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Eh, no worries,” Jake scratched the back of his head as he tried not to be impolite by staring too much. He did faintly feel as if he recognized the woman, though, and when he scoured his memories, he suddenly remembered.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: To Jake’s surprise, she listened and didn’t move her body. She did speak, tho.
